frontmatter.title: V13.3 Secret Management
when_to_use: storing or accessing application secrets, API keys, database credentials, or certificates
configuring environment variables or secret stores (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.)
rotating or auditing secrets used by the application
threats: secret exposure in source code or version control
secret leakage via logs or error messages
long-lived credentials not rotated after compromise
environment variable theft via process inspection
frontmatter.summary: Requirements for securely storing, accessing, and rotating application secrets and credentials.
